name: fantasy-football-tool
description: Browser regression tests for FOSS Football and the draft assistant.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test webapp/test_*.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s webapp -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s engine -p 'test_update_ranks.py'
